caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wooden chair with a high, decorative backrest. The seat and oval-shaped back are upholstered with fabric that features alternating vertical stripes in black and gold. The wood of the chair is dark and intricately carved, with highlights of gold, red, and white detailing on various parts, such as the legs, arms, and top crest. The crest has a fan-like design at the very top, and just below it is a small medallion displaying a profile of a classical figure set within a circular frame. Decorative finials extend from the top corners of the chair back. The legs are turned and fluted, with small gold and red accents. The background is a plain off-white color, with faint shading suggesting a floor and wall. There is a thin border framing the image, and the name "Charles Cullen" is signed in the bottom left corner.
title: Chair (one of a pair)
